genes.name: Lung adenocarcinoma

genes.name: Small cell lung carcinoma
genes.gene: TP53 and RB1 loss of function
genes.role: Both tumor suppressors lost in this neuroendocrine tumor with the strongest tie to smoking

genes.name: Small cell lung carcinoma
genes.role: Sometimes added on top of the two tumor-suppressor losses in the chromogranin- and synaptophysin-positive tumor
